name: Alchemy Jug

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Pour a liquid
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): the jug fills with a liquid you choose (acid, poison and oil become vials and flasks you can use).

summary: Once a day, it pours out the liquid you name: acid, poison, oil, water, wine and more.
text: The ceramic jug looks like it holds about a gallon, weighs 12 pounds no matter what is in it, and sloshes when shaken even if it's empty. As a Magic action, name a liquid and the jug fills with that liquid in a set amount: 1 gallon of wine, 4 gallons of beer, 8 gallons of fresh water, 12 gallons of salt water, 1 gallon of honey, 2 gallons of vinegar, 2 gallons of mayonnaise, 1 quart of oil, 8 ounces of acid, or 1/2 ounce of basic poison. It then won't produce anything again until the next dawn. Liquid flows out of it at a maximum of 2 gallons each minute.
